title.zh: 〔已證實〕ICS Patch Tuesday 9/8：Schneider Modicon M580 認證漏洞 CVSS 9.2，Siemens 九則（四則 Critical）、Rockwell 九則
title.en: [Confirmed] ICS Patch Tuesday on September 8: a CVSS 9.2 authentication flaw in Schneider's Modicon M580, nine Siemens advisories (four critical) and nine from Rockwell

content.zh:
**面向：OT 安全。**

**發生什麼**：9 月 8 日的 ICS Patch Tuesday 是近幾個月較重的一次。**Schneider Electric** 發布 4 則新公告並更新 8 則（其中一則原始發布於 2019 年），最嚴重的是 **Modicon M580 與 Modicon M580 Safety 控制器的認證漏洞 CVE-2026-3869，CVSS 9.2**。**Siemens** 發布 9 則新公告（**4 則為 Critical**）並更新 9 則。**Rockwell Automation** 發布 9 則，涵蓋 RSLinx Classic 的重大與高風險漏洞，以及 1756-ENBT 模組、FactoryTalk Historian ME、FactoryTalk Activation Manager、Redundancy Module Configuration Tool、ControlFLASH、ArmorStart 分散式馬達控制器，與 CompactLogix 5380／5480／5580、GuardLogix 5580、Compact GuardLogix 5380 控制器。**AVEVA** 另發布 1 則，涵蓋 Pipeline Integrity Monitor 的 4 個漏洞。

截至本期，**上述漏洞均無公開的在野利用證據**，因此評為持續留意而非高度關注。

**為何重要——對英業達的意涵**：這一則的重點不在單一 CVE，而在**修補節奏的結構性落差**。第一，**Modicon M580 是安全型（Safety）控制器**——這類設備的修補不是排維護視窗就好，往往需要重新驗證安全功能，實際可修補的時間點可能落在數週甚至下一個歲修，因此**緩解措施（網段隔離、管理介面存取限制、通訊協定白名單）才是這幾週真正能做的事**。第二，**Rockwell 這批的組成很值得注意**：RSLinx Classic 與 FactoryTalk 系列是**工程站與伺服器端軟體**，不是現場控制器——這類資產通常安裝在 Windows 上、由自動化工程團隊管理、且常被排除在 IT 的修補範圍外，卻是從 IT 網段進入 OT 的最短路徑。第三，本站 W36 已報導 CISA 9/1 的 8 則 ICS 通報中有 5 則集中在 Rockwell 的 Logix 平台與工程軟體——**連續兩期同一供應商的工程軟體出現密集公告**，這個模式對以 Rockwell／Siemens／Schneider 為主的產線環境是一個明確的優先排序訊號。

英業達六地佈局中，桃園與重慶、Juárez 的產線自動化資產若使用上述任一平台，本則即為實際待辦而非參考資訊。
content.en:
**Lens: OT security.**

**What happened**: The September 8 ICS Patch Tuesday was heavier than recent months. **Schneider Electric** published 4 new advisories and updated 8 (one originally issued in 2019), the most severe being **CVE-2026-3869, an authentication flaw in Modicon M580 and Modicon M580 Safety controllers, at CVSS 9.2**. **Siemens** published 9 new advisories, **4 of them critical**, and updated 9 more. **Rockwell Automation** published 9, covering critical- and high-severity flaws in RSLinx Classic plus the 1756-ENBT module, FactoryTalk Historian ME, FactoryTalk Activation Manager, the Redundancy Module Configuration Tool, ControlFLASH, ArmorStart distributed motor controllers, and CompactLogix 5380/5480/5580, GuardLogix 5580 and Compact GuardLogix 5380 controllers. **AVEVA** published one advisory covering four flaws in Pipeline Integrity Monitor.

As of this issue there is **no public evidence of exploitation in the wild** for any of these, hence the medium rather than high rating.

**Why it matters for Inventec**: the point is not any single CVE but **the structural gap in patch cadence**. First, **the Modicon M580 is a safety controller** — patching such devices is not simply a matter of booking a maintenance window; safety functions usually have to be revalidated, so the realistic patch date may be weeks away or at the next turnaround. That makes **mitigations — network segmentation, restricting management interface access, protocol allow-listing — the only thing actually available in the coming weeks**. Second, **the composition of the Rockwell batch deserves attention**: RSLinx Classic and the FactoryTalk family are **engineering workstation and server software**, not field controllers. Those assets typically run on Windows, are managed by the automation engineering team, and are routinely excluded from IT's patch scope — while being the shortest path from the IT segment into OT. Third, this site reported in W36 that 5 of the 8 CISA ICS advisories on September 1 clustered on Rockwell's Logix platform and engineering software — **two consecutive issues with a dense run of advisories against the same vendor's engineering software** is a clear prioritisation signal for plants standardised on Rockwell, Siemens or Schneider.

Across Inventec's six sites, if the production automation estate in Taoyuan, Chongqing or Juárez runs any of these platforms, this item is an actual task rather than background reading.

action.zh: (1) 兩週內完成一次比對：把本批公告涉及的產品型號與**產線自動化資產清單**對照，產出「受影響／不受影響／無法確認」三類清單——「無法確認」的數量本身就是一個要回報的指標；(2) Modicon M580（尤其 Safety 型號）**不要等修補**：本月內先完成緩解——確認控制器所在網段與 IT 網段之間無直通路徑、管理介面僅限工程站存取、並關閉不必要的通訊服務；(3) 把 **RSLinx Classic 與 FactoryTalk 系列的工程站與伺服器納入 IT 的修補管理範圍**（或至少納入資產與漏洞盤點），這是本則最具槓桿的一步——它們是 Windows 資產，卻常落在 IT 與 OT 的責任縫隙中；(4) 建立一條例行流程：每月 ICS Patch Tuesday 後 5 個工作日內由自動化工程與資安共同完成影響評估並記錄決議（修補／緩解／接受風險），這比逐次臨時處理更能撐得住稽核。
action.en: First, within two weeks, map the product models covered by this batch against the **production automation asset inventory** and produce three lists — affected, not affected, cannot determine. The size of the third list is itself a metric worth reporting. Second, **do not wait to patch the Modicon M580**, especially Safety models: complete mitigations this month — confirm there is no direct path between the controller segment and the IT segment, restrict the management interface to engineering workstations, and disable unnecessary communication services. Third, **bring RSLinx Classic and FactoryTalk engineering workstations and servers into IT's patch management scope** (or at minimum into asset and vulnerability inventory); this is the highest-leverage step here, because they are Windows assets that fall into the seam between IT and OT ownership. Fourth, establish a routine: within five working days of each monthly ICS Patch Tuesday, automation engineering and security jointly complete an impact assessment and record the decision (patch, mitigate, or accept risk). That holds up to audit far better than handling each round ad hoc.
